meta.title: Specimen Sorter API
meta.subject: lis-crs-spec-ack-svc — one POST to auto-register or send out from a USID
meta.author: LIS Team

slides.headline: Specimen Sorter API
slides.notes: Cover is identity only. TMP-000 is the dossier stand-in. Tony Chong reviewed the design note.

slides.title: Staff click today. The sorter will call LIS

steps.title: Scan and click
steps.body: Staff scan the specimen label on Specimen Acknowledgement and press Send-out or Register.

steps.title: Tubes go on a sorter
steps.body: Labs will load tubes onto a sorter for scan, sort, and transport.

steps.title: One LIS call, then a bin
steps.body: Middleware calls LIS so the sorter can bin from send-out or registration status.

callout.text: Specimen Acknowledgement remains the fallback when the sorter returns Relabel or Failure.

slides.notes: The gap is not the writes. Validation and packing still sit on the screen, so middleware cannot reuse the staff register call.

slides.title: The Spec Ack screen still owns validation and packing

rows.text: Validates. Groups tests, request no., maps ward and doctor

slides.notes: Amber is what moves. Group tests, request no., and ward/doctor mapping sit on registration, not on worksheet. Worksheet has its own convert, then print.

slides.title: One new POST on the Spec Ack service

code.caption: usid and sorterId are required. hospital may be omitted when the map has it.

findings.title: Same-call status
findings.body: REGISTERED, SEND_OUT, RELABEL, or FAILURE. Soft alerts stay off the body.

findings.title: Optional identity
findings.body: hkid and patientName. If sent and they mismatch, Failure.

findings.title: New path, not an overload
findings.body: Do not reuse the staff register call. No auth header in v1.

slides.notes: Hospital, if sent, must match the map and workbench. Unknown sorterId is Failure. Transport errors stay 500.

slides.title: Screen logic moves behind that POST

left.label: Today
left.title: On the screen
points: Then the screen calls register or print

right.label: Proposed
right.title: On the new API
points: Reuse register, worksheet print, and PHLC
Print and PHLC only after Registered

callout.text: Send-out, Relabel, and Failure print nothing. A late worksheet does not change a status already returned.

slides.notes: The API calls the same print and PHLC services Spec Ack uses today, in-process, not by looping back over HTTP.

slides.title: The map supplies hospital, workstation, and user

cards.title: New map table
cards.body: loe_specimen_sorter_map. Sorter id maps to a dedicated LIS user and a workbench.

cards.title: Derive from the map
cards.body: Hospital if the request omits it. Workstation and user from the same row.

cards.title: LOE_AUDIT_TRAIL
cards.body: Insert SORT_REG, SORT_SO, SORT_RELABEL, SORT_FAIL, plus REG and SEND_OUT.

callout.text: Add SORT_* to the Audit Trail action filter. Unknown sorter id is Failure. Printer stays on workbench.

slides.notes: Do not copy printer onto the map as a second source of truth. Do not compare workbench lab to the retrieved test lab.

slides.title: Seed user, workbench, and map, then deploy

cards.title: Create the sorter user
cards.body: Dedicated LIS user on the audit trail. Not a shared staff login.

cards.title: Seed a workbench row
cards.body: One row per sorter: hosp, lab, station name, location, printer.

cards.title: Insert the map row
cards.body: Sorter id, user, and workbench id on loe_specimen_sorter_map.

cards.title: Deploy and open the path
cards.body: Deploy lis-crs-spec-ack-svc. NetworkPolicy only. No API key in v1.

slides.notes: Pilot CPS and HMS. Relabel and Failure bins go back to staff Spec Ack. Add SORT_* to the Audit Trail filter.

slides.title: Stop middleware. Staff Spec Ack is unchanged

cards.title: Stop middleware
cards.body: Staff clicks still retrieve, send-out, and register.

cards.title: Drop the map table
cards.body: DROP TABLE loe_specimen_sorter_map on full rollback. Leave or disable the workbench and user.

cards.title: No history rewrite
cards.body: Do not convert historical requests. Fallback is operational.

slides.notes: The staff path is the fallback. Drop only the map table.

slides.title: Four decisions to ratify before build

asks.q: Leave v1 with NetworkPolicy only, no API key or Hub JWT?
asks.why: Same isolation as Spec Ack today (D1).

asks.q: Fail the tube when the USID has both local and send-out tests?
Print worksheets and PHLC only after Registered, after HTTP return?
Show SORT_* actions on the Audit Trail filter?

callout.text: Requester already answered D1-D11. This room ratifies.

slides.notes: Requester already answered D1-D11. This room is the ratification, not a new design pass.

slides.headline: Q&A
slides.notes: Likely questions: why a new POST; why hospital can be omitted; why DFT uses the same register path.

slides.headline: Target latency
slides.note: About 20 specimens a minute per lab in v1. Worksheet and PHLC sit after the sorter wait path.
